title: Internet publishing alerts
label: 06-Online Publishing Requirements
markdown:
# Internet publishing alerts

|  |
| --- |
| It should be labelled as news, science, knowledge presentation, experience sharing, consumption measurement or user notes for advertising purposes. |
| Use "System Update" "software error" "immediately clears" false tips such as "rewards" or use false play, start, pause, return signs to induce clicks. |
| Falsely closes the button, cannot close with one key, has to wait for the countdown, has more than two clicks to close or continues to pop up on the same page after closing. |
| Advertisements are sent without the consent of the user, at the request of the user, or after the user has expressly refused; the electronic message advertisement does not indicate the true identity, contact and rejection. |
| The front-end content of the link advertisement is compliant, but the landing page, the lower link or the jump page contains illegal propaganda. |
| The sale of medical, pharmaceutical, medical devices, health-care food or special-medical formulations with knowledge or the disguised content of the culture. |
